economic_hypothesis: After a decline of at least twenty percent from a known sixty-session high, a new sixty-session low with normal-or-higher turnover, a lower wick at least twice the candle body, and a close in the upper thirty percent records intraday capitulation absorption. Requiring the next completed session to close above the hammer high separates a visible reversal attempt from an unconfirmed wick.

frozen_signal.history: sixty completed same-symbol sessions hard-valid, tradable, market-rule-valid and corporate-action-valid
frozen_signal.confirmation: immediately next completed session closes above hammer high
frozen_signal.coordinate_lineage: unchanged through hammer and confirmation sessions

execution.entry: first legal executable daily open after completed confirmation, no later than three market sessions

order: highest median annual mean net return
